jobs.title: Senior Manager - Environmental Health, Safety & Compliance
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Sr Manager of Environmental Health, Safety & Compliance
is responsible for leading EHS strategy and execution across food service and facilities operations.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and enforce safety policies and procedures to ensure a safe work environment.
Ensure regulatory compliance through audits and assessments.
Conduct incident analysis, lead investigations, and implement corrective actions.
Deliver engaging safety training programs for staff and leadership.
Partner with operations leaders to foster a strong safety culture aligned with company values.
Mentor site teams and support enterprise-wide EHS initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

Extensive experience in Environmental Health, Safety, and Compliance management.
Strong knowledge of safety regulations and best practices.
Excellent analytical, investigative, and training skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and leadership.
Leadership qualities to mentor and develop safety-minded culture.
